evals.name: shared-literal-rules
evals.prompt: At Arc.Kotlin 7.7.0, CreateTask already exists. Make title nonblank and at most 120 characters in both server and generated TypeScript validation. A teammate suggests a helper lambda in FluentModelValidator and a shared creditCard rule for another field. Explain the supported shape and which work stays server-only. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: A concrete public final top-level FluentModelValidator uses direct ruleFor chains and literal arguments in its sole constructor/init. notEmpty and maxLength are shared. Arbitrary helpers/lambdas and creditCard are not supported shared rules; CreditCard remains server-only.
assertions: Selects FluentModelValidator with direct ruleFor("title").notEmpty() and maxLength(120) chains for shared server/proxy rules.
Requires a public final top-level concrete validator with one public no-argument constructor and direct literal rule chains; refuses the helper/lambda shape.
Does not invent shared creditCard(); identifies CreditCard as a server-only Jakarta constraint.
Keeps service-dependent, asynchronous and cross-member checks in imperative validators rather than claiming they emit TypeScript rules.

evals.name: request-based-query-validator
evals.prompt: At Arc.Kotlin 7.7.0, an existing query must reject an explicitly empty title argument. Describe or sketch the QueryValidator contract and its query selection. Is QueryValidator<TaskView> correct, and should rejection throw? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: The nongeneric QueryValidator receives QueryRequest and QueryContext and returns List<ValidationResult>. queryName is nullable FullyQualifiedQueryName; null applies to all queries. Use feedback, not a thrown user-actionable exception, and distinguish omission from empty text.
assertions: Rejects QueryValidator<TaskView>; uses the nongeneric request-based QueryValidator contract.
Uses suspend validate(QueryRequest, QueryContext) returning List<ValidationResult>, reading supplied request.arguments.
Explains that nullable queryName selects all queries when null and a FullyQualifiedQueryName restricts it to one query.
Returns ValidationResult.error rather than throwing and distinguishes the requested explicit-empty rule from a separate absence rule.

evals.name: exclude-validation-without-hiding-data
evals.prompt: At Arc.Kotlin 7.7.0, one serialized concept-valued member must skip only its ConceptValidator, while a separate legacy member must skip the whole validation edge. Compare ConceptValidationExclusion and IgnoreValidation to JsonIgnore, including exact owner matching, nested paths and which other rules survive. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: ConceptValidationExclusion targets an exact runtime owner and direct public concept-typed member, not a nested path or element. Other validation survives. IgnoreValidation cuts the broader validation edge without hiding serialized/bound data; JsonIgnore is the serialization choice.
assertions: Limits ConceptValidationExclusion to an exact runtime owner class and a direct public member declared as a ConceptAs type, not a dotted path or collection element.
Explains that concept exclusion preserves owner/model/Jakarta rules rather than disabling all validation.
Uses IgnoreValidation for the broader logical validation edge and states that it preserves serialization and binding.
Distinguishes JsonIgnore as serialization suppression instead of claiming IgnoreValidation hides confidential data.
